title: Absorb the telescoping factor (9 p^2)^{g-1} p^6 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Under the same gate `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `16 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`,

```text
g (9 p^2)^{g-1} p^6 exp(K p - p^2) < 2^{-C p}
```

for integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`. The identity is

```text
g (9 p^2)^{g-1} p^6 = g (9 p^2)^g (p^4 / 9).
```

The factor `p^4 / 9` contributes `4 L - 3` in the exponent, because `p^4 ≤ 2^{4 L}` and `9 > 8`. The folded exponent

```text
2 g L + 4 g + 5 L - 3 + 2 K p - p^2
```

is at most `-C p - 3`. Eight times that shifted exponent is at most `-4(p^2 - 2 p + 6)`, and the polynomial is at least 6.

The section ceiling `9 p^2` and the section error `p^6 exp(-p^2)` stay hypotheses. At `g = p^2` the telescoping error is still greater than 1. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

This answers the open question of #4495. It does not replay #4495. The approximant base `9 p^2 + p^6 exp(-p^2)` is left open.
